_meta.source: docs/VDJScript Verbs.md + docs/Official VDJScript Coverage Audit.md

auto_bpm_transition.description: Gradually move BPM toward the other deck

auto_pitch_lock.description: Engage pitch lock when BPMs are matched

automix_add_next.description: Add selected songs after current automix song

beat_juggle.description: Alternate beat jumps forward and backward

beatjump.description: Jump beats; the argument must be signed — bare `beatjump 4` was a no-op on `v2026-m b9482` (`Local test`)

bpm_stabilizer.description: Lock fluid track to current BPM

browsed_file_prepare_stems.description: Prepare stems for selected browser file(s)

browsed_file_reload_tag.description: Reload browsed file tag from source file

browsed_file_reveal.description: Reveal browsed song in OS file manager

color_mix.description: Mix two colors based on action

colorfx_prefader.description: Make ColorFX prefader for controller compatibility

controller_mapping.description: Assign a mapping to a controller

cross_assign.description: Assign deck to crossfader side or through state

deck_has_error.description: Sparse deck load-error helper; partial user-provided pad test exists

deck_options.description: Open the built-in deck behavior/options popup; useful from skin `rightclick=""` when a right-click-only deck menu is needed

dualdeckmode_decks.description: Dual-deck pair helper for decks 1/3 or 2/4

effect_arm_bpm.description: Get BPM of armed deck target

effect_arm_deck.description: Select target deck/path for armed FX

effect_arm_stem.description: Arm stems for `stems` slot effect actions

effect_bank_load.description: Load deck FX slots 1-6 from bank

effect_bank_save.description: Save deck FX slots 1-6 to bank

effect_bpm_deck.description: Set/get custom plugin BPM for this deck

effect_bpm_deck_tap.description: Tap custom plugin BPM for this deck

effect_clone.description: Clone all three FX slots from another deck

effect_colorfx.description: Select effect for a custom ColorFX slot

effect_disable_all.description: Disable deck/master effects; with `'padfx'`, clear temporary Pad FX as a broad reset

effect_select_toggle.description: Select effect and keep activation continuity

effect_slider_skip_length.description: Move slider while skipping length slider

fake_eq.description: Tell VirtualDJ not to apply EQ to sound output

fake_filter.description: Tell VirtualDJ not to apply filter to sound output

fake_gain.description: Tell VirtualDJ not to apply gain to sound output

fake_hp.description: Tell VirtualDJ not to apply headphone volume to headphone output

fake_hpmix.description: Tell VirtualDJ not to apply headphone mix to headphone output

fake_master.description: Tell VirtualDJ not to apply master volume to master output

fake_mixer.description: Tell VirtualDJ not to apply mixer volumes to sound output

fake_pfl.description: Disable skin PFL switching when PFL is controlled elsewhere

gain_relative.description: Move gain relative to software position

get_crossfader_result.description: Effective left/right deck mix after crossfader and levels

get_effect_slider_default.description: Get effect slider default (target + optional index + fallback → normalized 0-1). `'<effect>' <fallback>` reads it as text (`Local test`: `'Backspin' 1`→`0.5`; `Built-in skin`: Broadcast video skin uses `'active' 0.5`). `<slot> <index> <fallback>` is the deck-skin `<slider frommiddle=>` value form (returned `off` as text)

get_effect_slider_label_skip_length.description: Get effect slider label while skipping length slider

get_effect_slider_name_skip_length.description: Get effect slider name while skipping length slider

get_effect_slider_text_skip_length.description: Get slider text while skipping length slider

get_loop.description: Active loop length or default loop size

get_pitch_value.description: Get pitch on 0-200 scale centered on 100

get_rotation_cue.description: Cue point angle on jog display

get_rotation_slip.description: Slip point jog angle, otherwise normal rotation

get_sample_color.description: Get the actual stored color of a sample slot

get_sample_info.description: Read sample metadata such as `fullpath`, `group`, or `length`

get_sample_name.description: Get the name of an absolute sample slot

get_sampler_bank.description: Get the name of the active sampler bank

get_sampler_bank_count.description: Get the total number of sampler banks

get_sampler_bank_id.description: Get the numeric id of the active sampler bank

get_sampler_count.description: Get the number of slots in the current sampler bank

get_sampler_slot.description: Get the sampler slot that currently has focus

get_slip_time.description: Time that will resume when slip exits

get_vu_meter_left_peak.description: Left VU peak after master volume

get_vu_meter_right_peak.description: Right VU peak after master volume

goto_beat_in_bar.description: Canonical spelling of `goto_bar` from build `18.0.9583` (same verb id 106; `goto_bar` is now the alias). Put the song on its nth beat after the downbeat without losing sync.

invert_timecode.description: Switch/invert timecode control across available decks

is_audioonlyvisualisation.description: Check whether audio-only visualisation is running

is_using.description: Query whether a feature was recently used

karaoke_clear.description: Clear the karaoke list (new in build `18.0.9583`)

key_match_button.description: Match the other deck's key on first press, or reset key on second press

leftvideo_button.description: Button helper for left video source

load_pulse_active.description: Pulse when a new song becomes audible

loop_load_prepare.description: Prepare/load saved loop and query prepared state

mark_linked_tracks.description: Link decks 1 and 2 as related tracks

match_gain.description: Match gain to the other deck

midiclock_active.description: Toggle MIDI clock output to a controller

miditovst_active.description: Toggle MIDI routing to deck VST instruments/effects

mixermode.description: Query internal vs external mixer mode

not_played.description: Do not mark this deck's song as played

nothing.description: Do nothing; no-op, not an early return

os2l_scene.description: Trigger or queue an OS2L scene when the deck is audible

over_video.description: Force this deck's video output to video master

pad_bank2.description: Switch skin display between pads 1-8 and 9-16

pad_has_action.description: Check whether current page defines a pad action

pad_has_color.description: Check whether pad has color behavior

pad_has_menu.description: Check whether pad page has menu

pad_has_param.description: Check whether pad page exposes a parameter

pad_has_pressure.description: Check whether pad has pressure behavior

pad_pushed.description: Check whether pad is currently pressed

pitch_lock.description: Link pitch sliders between matched decks

playlist_add.description: Add selected songs to automix list

playlist_load_and_keep.description: Load first automix song and keep it

playlist_load_and_remove.description: Load first automix song and remove it

pulse.description: True for duration when action turns true

relay_play.description: Auto-start opposite deck at track end

repeat_song.description: Restart the current song when it reaches the end

repeat_start_fade.description: Fade from one value to another over a time, optionally in N steps (new in build `18.0.9583`)

rightvideo_button.description: Button helper for right video source

sampler_abort_rec.description: Cancel recording and delete the unfinished sample

sampler_assign.description: Assign a `.vdjsample` file to a slot

sampler_color.description: Get the color of the visible sampler pad slot

sampler_edit.description: Open the Sample Editor for a sample

sampler_group_color.description: Get the color of a sampler group

sampler_group_name.description: Get the name of a sampler group

sampler_group_volume.description: Adjust all samples in a sampler group

sampler_has_group.description: Check whether a group exists in the current bank

sampler_load_to_deck.description: Load the selected sampler slot to a deck

sampler_loaded.description: Check whether an absolute sampler slot has a sample loaded; do not rely on `"auto"` for paged empty-slot checks

sampler_loop.description: Change the loop length of a sample or set it explicitly

sampler_mode.description: Set global or per-sample trigger mode

sampler_options.description: Open or toggle sampler bank options

sampler_output.description: Route sampler output to master, trigger deck, headphones, etc.

sampler_pad.description: Trigger the currently exposed sampler pad slot; in display/name contexts it can also return the visible pad label

sampler_pad_shift.description: Stop a sample if playing, delete it otherwise

sampler_pad_volume.description: Set sample volume by visible sampler pad position

sampler_pfl.description: Send sampler to headphones or set sampler PFL volume

sampler_play.description: Play the selected or specified sample slot

sampler_play_stop.description: Play sample if stopped, or stop it if already playing

sampler_play_stutter.description: Play sample and restart it from the beginning if already playing

sampler_position.description: Get the current playback position of the selected sample

sampler_rec.description: Record a sample from the deck, mic, or master

sampler_rec_delete.description: Delete a sample from the Recordings bank

sampler_select.description: Select the default sampler slot for the deck

sampler_stop.description: Stop one sample or all currently playing samples

sampler_stop_rec.description: Stop recording and save the sample

sampler_used.description: Check whether any sample, or a specific count of samples, is playing

sampler_velocity.description: Velocity/pressure value for a sampler pad

sampler_volume.description: Set sample volume by absolute slot or sample name

sampler_volume_nogroup.description: Adjust one sample without also changing other samples in its group

saved_loop_autotrigger.description: Auto-trigger saved loop when playhead reaches it

saved_loop_prepare.description: Prepare/load saved loop or set it if missing

scratchbank_assign.description: Assign dropped file to scratchbank slot

scratchbank_load_to_deck.description: Load scratchbank slot to deck, or return its label/color in pad contexts

set_browsed_file_bpm.description: Set BPM for selected browser songs

set_loadpoint.description: Set where the track starts when loaded

set_mixpoint.description: Move automix/mix point to current position

setting_ismodified.description: Query whether setting differs from default

setting_setdefault.description: Change setting default for this session

setting_setsession.description: Force setting value for this session

setting_setsession_deck.description: Force deck-specific setting value for this session

shift_all_cues.description: Shift all cue points by a time offset

shoutout.description: Open a popup that creates an audio sample from typed text, no microphone needed (new in build `18.0.9583`; Button-Editor-hidden)

sidelist_load_and_keep.description: Load first sidelist song and keep it

sidelist_load_and_remove.description: Load first sidelist song and remove it

sync_hint.description: Query sync hint such as pitch or phase

timecode_pitch.description: Tell timecode engine a controller pitch-slider position

timecode_reset_pitch.description: Reset software pitch so deck pitch matches turntable pitch

video_crossfader_auto.description: Automatically move video crossfader based on deck activity

video_crossfader_link.description: Link video crossfader to audio crossfader

video_fadetoblack.description: Fade video to black from volume sliders
